text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the break, I spotted Espoir City alone in an empty classroom.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sine... squared, plus?
Cosine... squared... equals~? Equals what~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!
Don't go slackin' off now, me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"All that midnight cramming before the quiz...
This is do or die, dammit!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Espoir City didn't sleep well.
